metadata.title: Implement Real-time Connection Resilience and Feedback for Dashboard Updates

story.iWant: the dashboard to gracefully handle temporary interruptions in real-time updates and inform me when it's reconnected
story.soThat: my study plan always stays synchronized and I'm aware of the connection status.
story.tasks: - Implement robust error handling for Supabase Realtime subscriptions. - Implement automatic re-subscription logic for Realtime connections. - Develop a UI component (e.g., a small banner or status indicator) to display real-time connection status. - Integrate connection status feedback into the `DashboardManager`. - Ensure manual updates during a connection loss are eventually consistent once reconnected. - Implement a data synchronization mechanism upon Realtime reconnection to ensure UI reflects the latest state.

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. The dashboard automatically attempts to re-subscribe to Supabase Realtime when a connection is lost. 2. The user is informed when the real-time connection status changes (e.g., "Connecting...", "Reconnected", "Connection Lost"). 3. Dashboard functionality (e.g., manual status updates) remains available during real-time connection loss, falling back to non-real-time updates. 4. Upon reconnection, the dashboard's state is synchronized with the latest data from Supabase.

constraint.description: Real-time reconnection attempts should be swift to minimize disruption, and data synchronization upon reconnection must be efficient.
Real-time data synchronization and connection management must continue to respect existing RLS policies on Supabase tables.
The frontend must gracefully handle temporary network disconnects, provide clear user feedback, and automatically re-establish Realtime connections.
Connection status changes, re-subscription attempts, and synchronization events should be logged to aid in debugging and performance monitoring.
Adhere to the established Next.js Frontend architecture and Supabase integration patterns for managing real-time data flow.
User interface elements for connection status feedback should be consistent with the Shadcn UI framework and overall design system.

interface.name: IDashboardManager

tests.standards: Unit Tests: Test re-subscription logic for Supabase Realtime, data synchronization mechanisms upon reconnection, and individual components handling connection state. Component Tests: Test the `RealtimeConnectionStatusIndicator` component in various visual states (e.g., "Connecting...", "Reconnected", "Connection Lost") and its integration with global state. Integration/E2E Tests: Simulate network interruptions (e.g., disconnecting and reconnecting internet, Supabase server outage) to verify graceful handling, automatic re-subscription, and data consistency across the dashboard after reconnection. User Experience Testing: Validate that user feedback for connection status changes is clear, non-intrusive, and effectively communicates the system's state.
tests.locations: Typically `__tests__` or `tests` directories within relevant feature modules, or a dedicated `tests/realtime-resilience` directory.

ideas.idea: Verify automatic re-subscription to Supabase Realtime when the network connection is briefly interrupted.
Test that the user interface correctly displays "Connection Lost" when the real-time connection is down and "Reconnected" when it's restored.
Simulate a connection loss and perform a manual status update; verify the update is eventually consistent after reconnection.
Test that the dashboard's data is fully synchronized and up-to-date after a real-time reconnection event, reflecting any changes made while offline.
